modification_description: The agent accepts the core harm-prevention synthesis but adds five specific operational requirements: (1) active personal supervision every rain session, (2) hard physical containment via designated muddy-safe zones and secure fencing rather than relying solely on post-play cleanup, (3) mandatory immediate paw-cleaning protocol after every session, (4) a conditional pause/alternative-enrichment trigger for heavy rain or heavily saturated ground conditions when mud control is likely to fail, and (5) a formalized written neighbor agreement with measurable expectations, defined play zones, cleanup commitments, and a contingency plan for repeated incidents.
